quote.text: If in the first act you have hung a pistol on the wall, then in the following one it should be fired.
quote.author: Anton Chekhov, as recalled by Ilia Gurliand, 1904 — for an issue about things that are finished, and waiting

stories.kicker: Buy It Once · the dress shirt
stories.headline: Five Italian mill names, one address in Guanzate
stories.dek: The cloth label is the least reliable thing on a shirt. The two tests that work cost nothing: count the stitches on the cuff, and pinch the collar.

stories.kicker: The Big Picture · the par curve, read column by column
stories.headline: The long end did not lead. The two-year did
stories.dek: Monday’s selloff is being written up as a term-premium shock. The Treasury’s own curve says something narrower and more useful: this was a bet on the next meeting.

stories.headline: The brittle place
stories.dek: A country of twenty-three million supplies about a fifth of one social network’s traffic on earth — more than the United States. Two months before an island-wide election, somebody has built two hundred and ninety-four accounts on it and has not yet said anything political.

stories.headline: Three days after he refused it, the same seven days are being redrafted
stories.dek: Qatar’s mediators were to sit separately with each side in New York on Monday or Tuesday, on an amended version of the plan Washington turned down on Saturday. Neither capital has withdrawn anything.

stories.kicker: The Little Red Dot · the haze, week five
stories.headline: The plan announced on 4 September has a trigger at two hundred. Singapore has not been near it
stories.dek: The only thing cancelled so far was cancelled by a private organiser, at three in the morning, two hours before the gun.

stories.headline: The second chip company in twenty-five days to buy the layer above it
stories.dek: AMD is paying about eight point two billion dollars in its own stock for World Labs. It is signed, it is not closed, and the open-model commons now sits inside two GPU vendors’ balance sheets.

stories.kicker: Gear We’re Watching · on sale today
stories.headline: The feature you are paying the premium for shipped in early access
stories.dek: The Sonos Ace Ultra reaches general sale in Singapore today at S$699. Headphone Linking, the thing that justifies the price, is compressed stereo, needs Wi-Fi, and dissolves your speaker groups.

stories.headline: A ceramic pebble from 1988, and the movement inside it was built for something else
stories.dek: Louis Vuitton has revived the watch that predates its own watchmaking by fourteen years. The case is the achievement; the calibre is a hand-me-down.

stories.kicker: Culture Desk · the weekend of 25–27 September
stories.headline: The number-one film in America is seven years old and is selling a trailer
stories.dek: Three new wide releases opened well and reviewed better. A re-cut library title beat all of them.

stories.kicker: Raising Them Well · the platform question
stories.headline: Somebody finally asked teenagers which app it happened on
stories.dek: The answers differ enormously by platform — which is the first genuinely actionable finding in this field all year, and a pilot study with no odds ratios in it.

stories.headline: The sport where the map is the opponent
stories.dek: Two days from now, ninety-eight teams start a five-day race across Corsica with no satellite navigation at all. They will be handed the maps at the line.

stories.headline: Ten thousand is the wrong variable. The right one is your best thirty minutes
stories.dek: A hundred and three thousand wrist accelerometers say that how fast you walk during your briskest half hour does more work than how far you walk all day.

stories.headline: The race is in ten days and the cheap seats are the ones still on sale
stories.dek: Every row re-checked this week against the venue’s own page or the official seller. Two of the biggest names on it cannot be bought at any price.
